newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy March CPI seen at 0.1 pct m/m, 2.2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Italy March CPI seen at 0.1 pct m/m, 2.2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Italian March inflation is seen at 0.1 percent month-on-month and 2.2 percent year-on-year, according to analysts' estimates after preliminary data from 11 sample Italian cities on Friday.

February consumer prices stood at 0.1 percent month-on-month and 2.4 percent year-on-year. Economists in a Reuters survey had forecast a month-on-month rate of 0.2 percent and a year-on-year rate of 2.3 percent for March.
Florence, Naples, Bari and Palermo are the last of the 11 cities releasing preliminary March data on Thursday and Friday.
The 11 cities have a combined weighting of 75.66 percent on the national index. Final March CPI will be released by national statistics institute Istat on April 7.
